test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Nov 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If a man completes (3)/(7) work in 6 days, then how many more days will he require for completing the remaining work?
solution:
Given:

The man completes (3)/(7) work in 6 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Work done each day × Total time taken (in days)

Calculation:

Hence, the required time to complete the work = 6 ÷ {3 over 7} = 14 days.

Thus, (14 - 6) = 8 more days are needed. 

**∴ Then 8 days he will require for completing the remaining work.**
